title: Python + AWS + Azure Combined Training Programme
subtitle: 15-Day Integrated Training Program
overview: A 15-day integrated programme with explicit allocations: Python (4 days), AWS (6 days), Azure (5 days). Each day combines explained concepts, guided demonstration, practical lab work, and a knowledge check.

reasoning.curriculum_sequence: Foundation before implementation; implementation before scenario simulation; simulation before capstone.
reasoning.assessment_rule: Every five delivery days end with evidence-based assessment and feedback.
reasoning.day_design_rule: Every day contains concept learning, guided demonstration, practical activity, and a measurable outcome.

rules: Total days exactly match requested duration
Every day has topics, tools, lab, and Jira practice
Final day is reserved for capstone/certification when duration is 5+ days

checks: Specific practical lab for every day
Measurable learning objectives for every day

strengths: Every module has a delivery sequence with participant activity and evidence
Every module has a timed delivery plan
content_evaluation.score_meaning: Completeness of assessable delivery evidence, not technical accuracy

curriculum_decision_layer.allocation_rule: Use the exact day allocation provided for each requested technology; never borrow days from another technology.
curriculum_decision_layer.sequence_rule: Teach prerequisites and foundations before configuration, implementation, troubleshooting, and integrated practice.
curriculum_decision_layer.day_design_rule: Each day includes explanation, demonstration, guided hands-on work, lab evidence, and a knowledge check.
curriculum_decision_layer.integration_rule: Keep technology modules distinct, add integration days when both technologies of a pair are requested, and finish with one capstone that uses every technology.
curriculum_decision_layer.shared_topic_rule: A topic shared by several technologies, such as cloud computing concepts, is taught once by the first technology that covers it.
